observation.command: cd /workspace/.build-logs/stage && for d in dokumentenpruefung fristenmanagement dokumentensuche graph-api; do echo "== $d"; grep -nE "EXPOSE|CMD|ENTRYPOINT" $d/Dockerfile 2>/dev/null | tail -4; done
